title: Badrinath Yatra
desc: Devdutt's arrest derails Satyavati's pilgrimage. He succumbs to vices, neglecting his pregnant wife. Blinded by darkness, he invites Chandravati into their home, fracturing the family. Secrets unravel, leaving behind a trail of betrayal and destruction.

title: Hindustan Ki Kasam
desc: A pair of twins are separated at birth, where one grows up as a Hindu in India, the other is raised a Muslim in Pakistan. However, due to the issues between the countries, they are forced to be against each other.

title: Desh Premee
desc: Dinanath is a freedom fighter married to Bharati. During the freedom struggle, though freedom is won but, he looses Bharati - who leaves as she is affected by leprosy. He is given shelter in Bharat Nagar - as four underworld dons of Bharat Nagar.

title: Train To Pakistan
desc: The film is set in Mano Majra, which is a quiet fictional village on the border of India and Pakistan, close to where the railway line crosses the Sutlej River. The film develops around the love affair of small-time dacoit Juggut Singh (Nirmal Pandey), with a local Muslim girl, Nooran (Smriti Mishra).

title: Kohram
desc: Major Ajit is assigned to expose Major Sodhi, the man who attempted to kill the Home Minister and is now hiding under a guise. Major Ajit sets out on his mission, but when he learns Sodhi's reasons for doing what he did, Ajit joins hands with him.
